subject.title: Implement Mattermost DM voice calls with STT/TTS agent replies

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor Mattermost DM voice calling as a bundled Mattermost plugin capability and advance https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103842 toward landing?
rationale: The capability fits messaging-channel goals but creates a large optional native/WebRTC support commitment and a new configuration surface; repository evidence cannot authorize that long-term ownership automatically.

options.title: Sponsor and narrow
options.body: Use the linked PR as the canonical implementation, narrow it where practical, and require owner review plus real Calls and upgrade proof.

options.title: Split foundations first
options.body: Review a smaller Calls transport and single-turn foundation before accepting batching, barge-in, and cancellation behavior.

options.title: Route externally
options.body: Decline bundling and ask for an independently maintained Mattermost plugin if existing public SDK seams are sufficient.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and narrow
recommendation.body: Use the linked PR as the canonical implementation, narrow it where practical, and require owner review plus real Calls and upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest available cumulative Mattermost contribution signal and was identified by the prior review as the best product-routing candidate.
